subject_resolutions.resolution: Authorize only GP_BIND_002_ACTIVATION_OBSERVATION_DIAGNOSTIC_V1: before any future H4 action, a terminal agent may use existing approved read-only Config/ProfileStore surfaces to retain raw Config bytes/hash, observable backend/host, selected GameModeConfig index/ID/decoded row/ultimate_profile_id, ProfileStore STATUS, selected-profile readback/revision/payload hash, and prepared alternate-payload hash; it must state whether ActiveId or the in-memory Ultimate profile pointer is unavailable. No writes, mutation, restoration, reset, flash, build, artifact custody, source edit, repair candidate, work-order allocation, H1-H5 acceptance, or merge is authorized. The exact GP-BIND-002 failure and every non-transfer rule remain preserved.
